title: Rav Chanin bar Papa

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Eruvin 65a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.65a.21). Dikdukei Soferim gives the reading R' Chanina bar Papa.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Chanina reading is attributed to Dikdukei Soferim by Hyman; it is not a new manuscript collation.

The linked Bavli has Rabbi Chanin bar Papa. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1398&lang=en) files the notice under Rav Chanin bar Papa and directs readers to Rabbi Chanina. Hyman quotes the Chanina reading from Dikdukei Soferim.
